name: Marichadi Gutika (Vati)

sections.introduction: Marichadi Gutika (Vati) is known as one of the great ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from various mixture of herbs. This is known to treat the problem of respiratory system.
sections.ingredients:
Guda – Jaggery 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Yava Kshara – Hordeum vulgare 
 Dadima – Punica granatum 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients in its appropriate quantity, guda up to 96 grams, yava kshara up to 6 grams, maricha and pippali up to 12 grams and dadima up to 24 grams. 
 Powder all the ingredients and pounded with jiggery/guda. 
 Make pills from them. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Marichadi Gutika (Vati) is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation that is able to maintain the balance of Vata and Kapha dosha in the body. 
 It is very useful to get rid of respiratory conditions. It is an effective Ayurvedic medicine which is helpful in bronchitis, where it improves the immunity and reduces fever and along reduces inflammation in the airways. Helps to expectorate excess of the mucus, and thus reduces chest pain, helps in ease of breathing. It is also much beneficial in controlling asthma, it enhances the immunity to fight the allergy and having bronchodilator effect, provides satisfactory relief, by reducing breathlessness. It is also able to control the cough and relaxing the sufferer as well as provides soothing feeling in cold. It is beneficial in rhinitis too, boosts the immunity, and helps to reduce inflammation of the nose and relieves congestion and promotes easy elimination of mucus from the nose and, impart relief from sneezing and lessens the irritation in the throat.
sections.dose: Two tablets, two times a day, before or after meals.
sections.contraindications:
Semen quality may be affected by its long term use. 
 Take under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Marichadi Gutika (Vati) 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam Gutika prakarana 53. 
 Introduction 
 Marichadi Gutika (Vati) is known as one of the great ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from various mixture of herbs. This is known to treat the problem of respiratory system. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Guda – Jaggery 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Yava Kshara – Hordeum vulgare 
 Dadima – Punica granatum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients in its appropriate quantity, guda up to 96 grams, yava kshara up to 6 grams, maricha and pippali up to 12 grams and dadima up to 24 grams. 
 Powder all the ingredients and pounded with jiggery/guda. 
 Make pills from them. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Marichadi Gutika (Vati) is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation that is able to maintain the balance of Vata and Kapha dosha in the body. 
 It is very useful to get rid of respiratory conditions. It is an effective Ayurvedic medicine which is helpful in bronchitis, where it improves the immunity and reduces fever and along reduces inflammation in the airways. Helps to expectorate excess of the mucus, and thus reduces chest pain, helps in ease of breathing. It is also much beneficial in controlling asthma, it enhances the immunity to fight the allergy and having bronchodilator effect, provides satisfactory relief, by reducing breathlessness. It is also able to control the cough and relaxing the sufferer as well as provides soothing feeling in cold. It is beneficial in rhinitis too, boosts the immunity, and helps to reduce inflammation of the nose and relieves congestion and promotes easy elimination of mucus from the nose and, impart relief from sneezing and lessens the irritation in the throat. 
 Indications 
 
 Cold 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Rhinitis 
 Asthma 
 
 Dose 
 Two tablets, two times a day, before or after meals. 
 Contraindications 
 
 Semen quality may be affected by its long term use. 
 Take under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
